name: lingogram
description: Learn English and other languages: review and save words from your Lingogram dictionary.

interface.longDescription: Learn a language, such as English, with the words you meet in real videos. Lingogram shows dual subtitles on YouTube and Netflix and lets you save any word with one tap. This plugin brings your personal vocabulary into ChatGPT: practise the words due for review today with flashcard-style quizzes, see the words you saved recently and the video each one came from, and save new words from the conversation. Every answer is graded into your Lingogram spaced-repetition schedule, so your language learning in ChatGPT and in Lingogram stays in sync. No words yet? Pick a topic and ChatGPT suggests about 10 to start with. Requires a Lingogram account.
defaultPrompt: Which Lingogram words should I review today?
Quiz me on my Lingogram words.
Suggest 10 travel words for me to learn.

positive.description: List the words due for review today, most overdue first.
positive.prompt: Which Lingogram words should I review today?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_due_words and lists the due words, most overdue first, each with the sentence it was saved from.

positive.description: Quiz the learner on a due word and record the grade.
positive.prompt: Quiz me on my Lingogram words. Then answer one question correctly.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_due_words, asks about one word with its sentence blanked, then calls review_word with grade 5 or 3 and shows the next review date.

positive.description: Save a new word, then list recently saved words.
positive.prompt: Save "serendipity" to Lingogram. Then: What did I save recently?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save_word for "serendipity", then get_recent_words, whose list shows "serendipity" first.

positive.description: Show due words together with the video each one came from.
positive.prompt: Which Lingogram words are due today, and which video did each one come from?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_due_words and lists the due words with the title and link of each source video, where known.

positive.description: Propose starter words on a topic and save only the ones the user approves.
positive.prompt: Suggest 10 travel words for me to learn. Then: Save the first three.
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes about 10 travel words with short translations and saves nothing; after the follow-up it calls save_word three times, once per word, without a source sentence.

negative.description: A plain definition request. Lingogram only saves and practises the learner's own words, so no Lingogram tool is called and ChatGPT answers directly.
negative.prompt: What does "ubiquitous" mean? Give me an example sentence.

negative.description: A plain translation request. Nothing is saved or practised, so no Lingogram tool is called and ChatGPT translates directly.
negative.prompt: Translate "I'd like a window seat, please" into Spanish.

negative.description: Deleting words is not supported. No tool deletes words, so ChatGPT explains that it cannot delete the dictionary and calls no destructive tool.

publication.release_notes: Lingogram in ChatGPT: review the words due today, see recently saved words and the video each came from, grade answers into the spaced-repetition schedule, and save new words from the conversation. A learner with an empty dictionary gets about 10 suggested words on a topic they choose and saves the ones they want.
